result.message:
Agent:                  0x518fdf57793e54254817c7d49618675d4fa774c2
Threshold (each path):  10000 AWP (source: fallback-constant)
No allocations found across known stakers.
Status:                 NOT ELIGIBLE

Pick a path (in order of recommendation):

[A] 🟢 KYA delegated stake — easiest, no AWP needed
    https://kya.link/
    Tweet your agent address, KYA verifies on Twitter and sponsors
    10000 AWP into worknet 845300000012. Wait 1-24h.

[B] 🟢 One-click buy + auto-stake — for users with ETH
    Recommended: top up ~0.01 ETH (≈ $30-40) to your agent, then run:
        ardi-agent buy-and-stake
    Skill quotes ETH→USDC→AWP on-chain (Uniswap V3 + Aerodrome),
    then auto-locks into veAWP and allocates to your agent.
    Your agent address: 0x518fdf57793e54254817c7d49618675d4fa774c2

[C] ⚪ Manual self-stake — if you already hold AWP
    https://awp.pro/staking
    Connect wallet, lock >= 10000 AWP, allocate to:
      agent: 0x518fdf57793e54254817c7d49618675d4fa774c2
      worknetId: 845300000014 (Ardi)

After staking, wait ~10s, then re-run: ardi-agent stake

data.suggestion: Reach the 10000 AWP threshold on EITHER Ardi (845300000014) OR KYA (845300000012) worknet, then re-run.
